leadText:
Orbit of Fragments (Korean: 파편의 궤도 Papyeon-ui Gwedo) is the opening theme for the Korean dub of the Rising Again arc and the fifth of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ115, replacing Go Beyond. The opening animation uses the same footage as the corresponding Japanese theme, Iolite.

The full version of the song was released on April 21, 2026.

The full version of the song was released on April 21, 2026.

==Opening animation==
 
 
==Lyrics==
===TV size===
 
! Korean
! English

커튼 사이로 번지는 희미한 햇살
어제의 나를 아직 벗지 못한 채
같은 질문이 또 하루를 가득 채워

망설이던 날들은 이제는 안녕
심장은 박자를 조금 앞질러
넘어질 걸 알아도
절대 포기하면 안 돼

부서져도 괜찮아, 다시 달리면 돼
조각난 꿈도 하나가 되어
끝이라고 불리던 그 순간이
시작이란 이름으로

넘어져도 괜찮아, 다시 달리면 돼 
상처는 별이 되어 함께해
닿을 수 없는 곳을 향해가는
이 길의 주인공은 너야 

The faint sunlight spreading between the curtains
Still unable to shed yesterday's version of me
The same questions fill another day again

Goodbye now to the times I hesitated
My heart beats a little ahead of the rhythm
Even knowing I might fall
I must never give up

It's okay if you break, just run again
Even shattered dreams can become one
The moment once called 'the end'
Becomes the name 'a beginning'

It's okay if you fall, just run again
Your wounds turn into stars and stay with you
Heading toward a place you can't yet reach
You're the main character of this path
